about.title: About Camel Global
about.hero.title: Car hire that comes to you.
about.hero.body: Camel Global was born on the theory that picking up a hire car shouldn't mean queuing at an airport desk or taking a bus to an off-site depot. Your car should be waiting for you — exactly where you need it, exactly when you need it.
about.whatWeDo.title: What we do
about.whatWeDo.p1: Camel Global is a meet & greet car hire platform — think of it like Uber, but for car hire. Instead of you going to the car, a driver from a trusted local car hire company delivers it directly to your chosen location: your hotel, your home, the airport arrivals hall, wherever works for you.
about.whatWeDo.p2: You tell us where you need a car, when, and for how long. We send your request to verified car hire partners within 30km of your pickup point. They compete for your business by placing bids. You pick the offer that suits you — on price, on car type, on rating — and the booking is confirmed instantly.
about.whatWeDo.p3: At the end of your hire, the driver collects the car from wherever you are. You only pay for the fuel you've actually used, calculated to the nearest quarter tank. No surprises, no hidden charges.
about.howItWorks.title: How it works
about.step1.title: Submit a request
about.step1.body: Tell us your pickup location, drop-off point, dates, and the type of car you need. It takes about two minutes.
about.step2.title: Receive bids
about.step2.body: Verified local car hire partners near you see your request and place bids. You get to compare them side by side.
about.step3.title: Accept an offer
about.step3.body: Choose the bid that works for you. The booking is confirmed immediately and the partner is notified.
about.step4.title: Car delivered to you
about.step4.body: A driver delivers your car to your chosen location at the agreed time. Insurance documents are confirmed on handover.
about.step5.title: Drive
about.step5.body: Enjoy your hire. When you're done, drop the car to the agreed drop off and a driver will come and collect the car.
about.step6.title: Pay only for fuel used
about.step6.body: Fuel is recorded at delivery and collection. You pay only for what you've used, rounded to the nearest quarter tank.
about.whyCamel.title: Why Camel Global
about.whyCamel.p1: Traditional car hire is broken. Prices are opaque, pickup locations are inconvenient, and the experience at the desk is rarely pleasant. We believe there's a better way — one that puts you in control, brings competition to your doorstep, and rewards good car hire companies with good reviews.
about.whyCamel.p2: Meet & greet car hire is already in high demand but underserved by technology. We've built the platform to scale — with full support for EUR, GBP, and USD, so expanding internationally is straightforward.
about.whyCamel.p3: We're a team with a clear goal: make car hire as easy as ordering a taxi.
